craft_notes: Sthāyin: Longing to see and stay; vow. Sthāyin: hunger to contemplate. Device: comma→dash (ache held, question released); hammer kept. Vṛtti bhāvātkaṃ gloss noted, image kept literal. Rejected: smoothing bhāvatka — killed: marked, never smoothed. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Blest One — be! — the ache to brood thy shadowy being —
keen to cut rebirth's scare: whom would it not please?
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhagavan bhava bhāvatkaṃ bhāvaṃ bhāvayituṃ ruciḥ punarbhavabhayocchedadakṣā kasmai na rocate
